title: A Comprehensive View of the Biases of Toxicity and Sentiment Analysis Methods Towards Utterances with African American English Expressions
reasoning: The paper evaluates and compares several NLP models to identify systematic biases against African American English (AAE). While it contains a mandatory section on ethical considerations and mentions religion when summarizing previous research, its primary focus and empirical evaluation are centered on racial/dialectal bias rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
